gates.description: Bounded contexts must be identified and documented
Aggregates with invariants must be defined
Ubiquitous language glossary must be created
Business invariants must be explicitly documented

anti_patterns.description: Entities with only getters and setters — all logic in service classes
No bounded contexts — one giant model where everything references everything
Starting with the database schema and generating code from it
One entity (usually User or Order) with 50 properties and 30 methods
Engineers building the model alone with technical terms instead of business terms

escalation_triggers: Domain experts disagree on how a business process works
A discovered invariant conflicts with existing system behavior in production
Two bounded contexts need to share an aggregate
Domain model reveals a business rule that contradicts documented requirements
Performance requirements force denormalization violating the domain model structure

output_certifications: Bounded contexts identified with clear boundaries
Ubiquitous language glossary created and shared
Context map showing relationships between contexts
Domain events defined for all significant state changes
